instruction: Transform the OIP.jpg image from /home/user into a PDF document and store it as 'receipt.pdf' on your Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting OIP.jpg to PDF and saving to Desktop. Evaluator validates: (1) file exists at correct location (0.3), (2) file size >= 10KB indicating real content (0.3), (3) valid PDF with pages (0.4). The 10KB threshold ensures the PDF contains actual image data, not just an empty document.

scoring_breakdown.1.0: Valid PDF with at least one page

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: file location (/home/user/Desktop/receipt.pdf), valid PDF format, and meaningful content
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter - directly accesses rules dict with 'expected.get("min_size", 10240)' which is correct for type="rule"
Partial credit scoring is logical and well-designed: file exists (0.3) -> has minimum size (0.6) -> valid PDF with pages (1.0)
File size threshold of 10KB is reasonable to ensure actual image data was converted, not just an empty PDF
Robust error handling with try/except blocks that return partial scores on failure
Getter (vm_file) can successfully extract the file from the correct VM path
No postconfig needed - file operations don't require UI state preservation
